posts.name: arenson9
posts.cooked:
jffdougan:

Care to give us a summary of the game? 

 

Advanced Baron Blade in Silver Gulch.

Fanatic, Tachyon, Bunker, and Wraith (though maybe not that order)

 

It was a bit close getting past the front side. Baron Blade got 15 cards in the trash, but was knocked to zero before it got back to his start of turn. He had 26 hit points and 13 (I think) cards in the trash at one point.

As expected, only the front side was much of a challenge. The question on the back side was more about how quickly Baron Blade would get knock out and who would get the final blow.
